credentials.description: DashScope API key. Required unless `apiKey` or `apiKeyProvider` is set in settings.
Fallback API key, read when `ALIBABA_API_KEY` is not set.

notes: Qwen chat models, DashScope text embeddings and Wan video generation through Alibaba Cloud's international DashScope endpoint. Supports thinking controls, JSON Schema output on newer Qwen models, and asynchronous video tasks that are polled until completion.
